RadioLib source in this directory is a minimal source subset from the
RadioLib 7.7.1 release, tag commit 034126ef3b5305394d1e4e14a5049482ec10c1c4.
Upstream: https://github.com/jgromes/RadioLib/tree/7.7.1
RadioLib source is MIT licensed; see LICENSE. The upstream binary patch data in
src/modules/SX126x/patches/SX126x_patch_scan.h carries a separate BSD-3-Clause
notice, reproduced in that header and included in package license metadata.

This subset contains the generic HAL, Module, PhysicalLayer and utility code
needed by the SX1262 driver. RadioLib's other radio modules and protocol
implementations are not included.
